annotations.title: List a host's open mock slots

description: The open 60-minute mock-interview slots of one host, by handle, and the topics that host offers. Each slot's starts_at is the exact RFC 3339 instant to book. Covers the next 30 days unless from/to say otherwise, at most 62 days. Never includes a meeting link.

timezone.description: IANA time zone the times are shown in, e.g. Europe/Berlin. An unknown or missing zone falls back to UTC; the result names the zone it used.

to.description: Window end, RFC 3339. Default 30 days after from.
